I filled out the form on your pricing page and wanted to request a short demo focused on inference cost and deployment options. Our team at CopperLane is budgeting for an LLM pilot (estimate $60k–$90k ARR) and we want to understand:

- data residency options (AWS us-west)

I've attached a 1-pager with our current stack and some procurement questions. Can you propose a 30–45m slot and include an SE if possible?
